A few suggestions I have:
- Change the order of the 2 currencies that are being exchanged as it feels counterintuitive. In my opinion (and having seen it like this in other apps) it would make sense for the currency at the top to be the currency you want to swap from and the one below should be what you want to swap to
- Would be helpful if you can search for other Wio users by a username or phone number.
- Would be great if you can customise app notifications
- Refer a friend feature
- Be able to deposit money using Apple Pay

Thank you for making banking in the UAE easier!
